name: Raffles Doha
insider_take: Where Arabian heritage meets French luxury in Qatar's most prestigious address, overlooking the glittering skyline of West Bay.
whats_special: This ultra-luxury hotel occupies the top floors of Qatar's iconic Katara Towers, offering unparalleled views of the Persian Gulf. The property features Qatar's highest infinity pool and houses one of the Middle East's most extensive art collections, including pieces by renowned Qatari artists. Each suite comes with a dedicated butler service, continuing Raffles' legendary tradition of personalized hospitality.
pro_tip: Book a Gulf-facing suite for breathtaking sunrise views over the Corniche, and time your visit during cooler months (November-March) to fully enjoy the spectacular rooftop amenities.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature restaurant by Michelin-starred chef, the world-class Cinq Mondes Spa with traditional hammam experiences, and easy access to Katara Cultural Village - Qatar's premier cultural destination featuring museums, galleries, and the stunning Blue Mosque just minutes away.
pros: Iconic luxury brand with legendary service heritage
Prime location in Doha's cultural and business district
Sophisticated blend of Middle Eastern and colonial design
Access to Accor HERA Program benefits and privileges
cons: Formal atmosphere may not suit casual travelers
